claims.text: Arkansas-Pine Bluff allows more goals than any two programs Even VMI and Chicago State, the next highest in the Southern and Northeast conferences, conceded fewer goals together than the SWAC side did alone. Arkansas-Pine Bluff's season is over, leaving that defensive total unmatched across the division.
claims.note: "any 2 others" was held against the strongest 2: vmi 72 + chicago-state 60
